_doc: What a character swore, who they owe, and who owes them — the relationship layer between the sixteen. Nothing here is migrated; this pool is empty on purpose and fills as oaths are authored. An oath may name another character, which is what turns sixteen separate people into a cast.

_schema.display_name: Shown on the reveal and party screens.
_schema.blurb: One line. What was sworn, and to whom.
_schema.text: The authored history, a short paragraph.
_schema.toward: Optional hero id this oath is sworn to, owed to, or held against. Casting keeps both ends consistent.
_schema.gift: Optional, same closed vocabulary as backgrounds: doctrine | item | gold | grudge | hearth | bond | stat.
